text: ModIsom (B. Eick, a GAP package): NilpotentQuotientOfFpAlgebra, the nilpotent quotient of a finitely presented associative algebra. According to its documentation it works over a finite field (the example and the field fld of the result), that is, it gives $\mathbb F_p[G]/\Delta^n_{\mathbb F_p}$, the Jennings series $M_n$, not the integral $D_n$. Support for $\mathbb Z$ was not checked in the sources †. The algorithm: B. Eick, Computing nilpotent quotients of associative algebras and algebras satisfying a polynomial identity, IJAC 21 (2011), doi:10.1142/S0218196711006649 †.

text: Conclusion. The identity $\mathbb Z[G]/\Delta^n\cong A_n/J_n$ is classical. Its computational use for the integral $D_n$, that is, linear algebra over $\mathbb Z/p^E$ or $\mathbb Z$ in $A_n$ of a size that does not depend on $|G|$, we have not found in the literature we searched. The search was not exhaustive.
